profile_text.body:
Micron Technology is a publicly traded semiconductor company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, trading under the ticker MU. On its own site the company describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage, saying its semiconductor solutions power AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge. It also states that mobile memory and storage accelerate AI-driven technologies for end users.

The site's material is aimed largely at engineers and buyers rather than at describing AI models. It offers data sheets and technical documentation, design tools and resources for testing and building high-performance solutions, an online source for placing and tracking orders for Micron memory samples, sales support contact, and enrollment in what it calls its Technology Enablement Program.

Beyond that, the record is sparse. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are tracked for the company. Its legal exposure is recorded in Idaho, with 21 matters, and its SEC filing record carries CIK 0000723125.
